record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare AURASPHERE: Riolu (1 star) and Lucario (2 stars); both have maxPP 80, range 2 and no declared passive. The strategy is shared; the only unit difference is the star count (table index). Registry key is AURASPHERE; the class is AuraSphereStrategy in aura-sphere.ts.
record.summary: SPECIAL 25 / 50 / 100 / 200 (fallback 200) and then ONE silence attempt of 3000 ms on each OPPOSING occupant along the actual effectInLine / getCellsBetween walk from the caster toward the target and on to a rounded 12-unit endpoint, interleaved cell by cell (damage then silence per unit). No application roll, but Rune Protect or the tree flag can refuse the silence, and weather / reductions change its stored duration. Allies on the line and off-line units are skipped.

targeting.who: every enemy-team entity on the cells of the supercover line from the caster's cell toward the cast target and on to a point 12 cells away along the same angle (clipped to the board); the caster's own cell is filtered out as same-team
targeting.note: The target only fixes the line's angle (the walk is the real getCellsBetween supercover, diagonal crossings included). Executed: the walk reaches the target's own cell for all 2256 ordered distinct position pairs of the ordinary 8 x 6 board (an enumeration of that board, not a proof for other boards), enemies behind the target are hit too, allies and off-line enemies are skipped. effectInLine itself has no fallback that touches the original target.

geometry.shape: line (supercover) from the caster through the cast target to the board edge; every touched cell counts, diagonal crossings included

effects.target: each enemy-team unit on the line (each cell visited once)
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1] per enemy hit, no falloff along the line. handleSpecialDamage: x(1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); x critPower (reduced by the hit unit's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT).
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; 0 when the unit has protect / skydiving / magicBounce. The return value is not read by the strategy.

effects.target: each enemy-team unit on the line
effects.scaling: none by AP or crit: the duration is the literal 3000 (requested). Applied: Rune Protect or a tree target prevents it; MURKY weather x1.3; SWIFT_SWIM x0.7, HYDRATION x0.5, WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER x0.3 (first matching); ODD_KEYSTONE on the hit unit's player multiplies by (1 - 0.1 x stones); the timer only replaces a shorter remaining silence.
effects.resolution: Silenced units have canCast false. The silence is requested even when the damage was blocked by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (those only stop the damage call; executed). Silence ends when its timer runs out (updateSilence).

statusEffects.target: each opposing occupant on the line, right after its own damage call
statusEffects.scaling: none: the duration is the literal 3000 (no AP / crit / star scaling).
statusEffects.guards: No application roll: every opposing occupant is attempted. Refused by Rune Protect or the tree flag (executed); a Protected unit takes 0 damage but is still silenced.
statusEffects.combatEffect: Stored duration: x1.3 in MURKY (3900), then the victim's reductions (HYDRATION 1500), Odd Keystone; the timer replaces a shorter remaining silence only (9000 kept). Silenced units have canCast false; silence ends when its timer runs out (updateSilence).

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 100 and 200 (fallback) entries are declared in the tables but unused by the bound baseline classes (Riolu 1, Lucario 2). Silence duration does not depend on stars.

record.positionalConditions: Which enemies are hit depends on the caster and target coordinates (angle rounding of the line end point); needs a target within the unit's range 2 to cast, because requiresTarget is true.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP and recomputes the line; a new silence only extends the timer if longer.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 25 / 50 (Riolu / Lucario) per opposing occupant on the line, silence 3000 ms. Requested = raw; applied damage = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit], then SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1); stored silence = 3000 after MURKY / reductions / Odd Keystone unless Rune Protect or the tree flag refuses it.

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (effectInLine, getCellsBetween, triggerSilence, handleSpecialDamage) and the real AuraSphereStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units with controlled callbacks (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, section CATCHUP_E4); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed (real Board walk, stand-in units): the damage-then-silence interleaving along the walk, ally and off-line skipping, the diagonal case, the target-cell enumeration, and the Rune / tree / MURKY / HYDRATION / longer-timer / Protected cases.
